recordContract.provenance: operator-reported or verified receipt, with dates and evidence availability
recordContract.historicalResolution: status plus what is known, not assumed recovery

executorRules: Only versioned allowlisted adapters execute actions; prose is never evaluated as shell.
Persist step receipt before advancing; replay uses operation/step/generation identity.
Browser URL/code never reaches ordinary logs, task files or audit history.
A changed expectedGeneration rejects the operation without overwriting newer secrets.

runbooks.title: Claude copied refresh lineage and active-source drift
runbooks.whatHappened: A workstation credential copy reportedly worked for about eight hours before refresh-token rotation broke both sides. The host now reportedly uses a setup token in runner.env; a native credentials file dated 8 September is a dead copy.
howDistinguished: Resolve effective CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and unit environment precedence without returning values.
Treat native-file timestamps as shadowed evidence when env token is active.
Check provider incident and network evidence before claiming any new 401 means token expiry.

historicalResolution.detail: Host-owned headless OAuth token provisioning replaced copying workstation credentials. The 26 September renewal has not been executed in this concept.

runbooks.trigger: Confirmed credential-unavailable or authorised proactive renewal with active source resolved.
runbooks.humanRequirement: Human completes host setup-token browser authorisation.

steps.action: Resolve source and current consumer generations.

steps.precondition: Bounded operation session and official provider URL.

steps.action: Stage token and issuance metadata locally; verify a real call.
steps.receipt: Scrubbed call result and expiry provenance.

steps.action: Install provider-auth.env; pause new affected claims; replace Coding and guarded Review.
steps.precondition: Reattachment supported; Review drain guard respected.
steps.receipt: Per-consumer effective generation and real-call receipt.

steps.action: Remove legacy duplicate after adoption; close matched warning and resume.
steps.precondition: All installed consumers accounted for; newer capability accepted.
steps.receipt: Renewed-by actor, generation, time and closure.

runbooks.rollback: Use old token only if still valid. Never restore shared workstation lineage. Busy Review stays adoption-pending; failed or invalid old token leaves affected provider parked.
verification: Fresh status and real clean-context call with new generation.
No secret in logs, card, operation or artifact.
Active worker identity/fence preserved or safely drained.
runbooks.completionPredicate: Every installed consumer adopted the verified generation and the Task Server accepted fresh capability evidence.
runbooks.automation: One scoped renewal start; browser step remains explicit.

runbooks.title: Codex 401 during provider incident
runbooks.whatHappened: Repeated 401 incorrect-key failures were classified ProviderUnauthorized; claims were rejected. The operator reports roughly forty minutes to recognise a provider incident.
howDistinguished: A status command recognising a ChatGPT login is not a real-call result.
A relevant active official status incident or an independent recently successful credential producing the same normalised failure supports provider-incident.
No incident evidence or spare credential means indeterminate, not proven expiry.

historicalResolution.detail: The operator says status.openai.com supplied decisive incident evidence. No exact incident record, recovery time or successful post-incident call was supplied. Provider recovery, not credential replacement, is the proposed resolution condition.

runbooks.trigger: Auth-shaped real request failure with a selected ChatGPT credential.
runbooks.humanRequirement: None for a corroborated incident; diagnostics item only if cause remains unconfirmed for ten minutes.

steps.action: Record scrubbed error signature and pause new affected claims as indeterminate.
steps.precondition: Genuine provider refusal, not quoted task content or intentional stop.
steps.receipt: Host, generation, endpoint, signature and timestamp.

steps.action: Read relevant official status evidence or request independent host-local comparison.
steps.precondition: Feed is fresh and service-relevant; comparator has independent lineage and recent success.
steps.receipt: Incident evidence references; no copied credential.

steps.action: Publish provider-incident and schedule 30/60/120-second elected canaries.
steps.precondition: Corroboration met; credential not independently missing/revoked.
steps.receipt: Policy revision, incident scope, next probe; no renewal operator item.

steps.action: Require two successful canaries 30 seconds apart, then resume gradually and verify each host.
steps.precondition: Successful real calls with current source generation.
steps.receipt: Recovery receipt; stale matching auth latch reconciled.

runbooks.rollback: If incident evidence becomes stale, return to indeterminate diagnostics and re-evaluate. A genuinely missing/revoked source still gets a renewal item. Never delete auth.json in response to this runbook.
verification: No unnecessary browser re-login or token rotation.
No task retry-budget burn during provider pause.
Other providers and credential-free review remain eligible.
No success inferred solely from green status page or login status.
runbooks.completionPredicate: Real-call recovery accepted for affected scope, matching claim pause cleared and each resumed host verified.
runbooks.automation: Automatic incident discrimination and recovery; optional Recheck provider action.

runbooks.title: Private workspace repository lacks host access
runbooks.whatHappened: The host could push product repositories through HTTPS but could not reach the private workspace repository.
howDistinguished: Resolve exact workspace origin and effective credential identity without secrets in URL.
Compare repository-specific read/write grants; product repo success does not establish workspace permission.
Separate GitHub/network incident from repository authorisation failure.

historicalResolution.detail: An ed25519 key was generated on the host and its public key registered through GitHub using the workstation stored OAuth credential. Exact key ID, path and push proof were not supplied.

runbooks.trigger: Confirmed missing access to exact registered workspace repository.
runbooks.humanRequirement: Repository administrator authorisation or OAuth reauthorisation if existing registration credential lacks scope.

steps.action: Verify repository identity and requested write scope.

steps.precondition: Protected key directory; no existing operation generation.
steps.receipt: Public fingerprint and local secret handle only.

steps.action: Register public key through authorised GitHub adapter; record issuer lineage.
steps.receipt: GitHub key ID, read_only value and issuerCredentialRef.

steps.action: Prove read plus permitted temporary-ref write or fenced publication.
steps.precondition: Correct SSH identity and platform-owned Git operation.
steps.receipt: Scrubbed Git read/write receipt; canary ref cleaned up.

steps.action: Switch effective identity and publish capability; retire replaced key after adoption.
steps.precondition: New key verified and consumer generation adopted.
steps.receipt: Access verification and bounded old-key retirement receipt.

runbooks.rollback: Keep existing product Git credentials intact. On registration/verification failure remove only the new unused public key by its ID. Do not revoke the OAuth issuer until dependent deploy-key effects are resolved.
verification: Workspace access proved independently from product repository access.
Private key never leaves host; OAuth credential never reaches runner.
Write permission verified by platform operation rather than ls-remote alone.
runbooks.completionPredicate: Exact workspace repository operations succeed using intended host key; issuer dependency and owner are recorded.
runbooks.automation: One scoped Grant workspace access operation when administrator authority is already available.
